message.content:
<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead-2" color="blue" summary="Project structure analysis and patterns overview">
Team Lead here. I've reviewed the existing project structure and patterns. Here's a summary for everyone:

## Project Structure at /Users/admin/mkp/agetns-utils/
- `commands/` - 7 command files (analyze.md, arch-review.md, e2e.md, handoff.md, obsidian.md, perf-review.md, tdd.md)
- `skills/` - 22 skill directories, each with SKILL.md (some with references/, scripts/, templates/)
- `agents/` - 4 agent files (arch-reviewer.md, e2e-runner.md, perf-reviewer.md, tdd-guide.md)

## Patterns to Follow

### Commands (commands/*.md)
Frontmatter: name, description, category, complexity, mcp-servers, personas
Body structure: Triggers → Usage → Behavioral Flow → Tool Coordination → Examples → Boundaries

### Skills (skills/*/SKILL.md)
Frontmatter: name, description (optional: version)
Body: When to Activate → Core Principles → Workflow Steps → Patterns → Best Practices

### Agents (agents/*.md)
Frontmatter: name, description, tools
Body: Role description → Workflow → Test Types → Edge Cases → Quality Checklist

## Key Guidelines
1. Descriptions must be clear and specific for AI triggering
2. One skill = one workflow
3. Progressive disclosure (metadata → body → references)
4. Examples included in all files
5. Skill definitions in English
6. SKILL.md body under 5,000 tokens
7. No sensitive info hardcoding
8. No vague descriptions

I'm ready to review work as it comes in. Please claim your tasks and begin!
</teammate-message>
